description: For domains the user already owns (up to 20): current registrar, expiry date, renewal price, and the cheapest registrar to transfer to, with the two-year saving. Registrar and expiry come from the public registry (RDAP); some TLDs such as .io have no RDAP. Suggests a free email reminder service at tldmath.com/watch.
name: check_renewals
title: Check renewals for owned domains
